narration:0:1320718101:1.text: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:0:1320718101:1.male: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:0:1320718101:1.female: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.

narration:1:1320718102:1.text: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:1:1320718102:1.male: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:1:1320718102:1.female: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.

narration:2:1320718103:1.text: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:2:1320718103:1.male: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:2:1320718103:1.female: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.

say:4:1320718104:1.text: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:4:1320718104:1.source_cn: 不久之后，也许你又要踏上新的旅途，我再存一点旅费也会离...
say:4:1320718104:1.male: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:4:1320718104:1.female: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.

say:5:1320718105:1.text: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:5:1320718105:1.source_cn: 某天，我们在伊索米亚的某个地方再度相遇时，我再为你弹奏...
say:5:1320718105:1.male: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:5:1320718105:1.female: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.

say:6:1320718106:1.text: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:6:1320718106:1.source_cn: 好啦，时候不早了，再不回去的话，格尔达该着急了。
say:6:1320718106:1.male: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:6:1320718106:1.female: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.

say:11:1320718109:1.text: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:11:1320718109:1.source_cn: 噫！刚才的旋律把那些怪物引过来了！救救救救命！
say:11:1320718109:1.male: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:11:1320718109:1.female: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
